title: Signer Registry Schema
description: Authoritative map of signing keys to authorized models. Nano uses this to verify intent source authority before any governance evaluation.

signers.description: Map of signing_key_id to signer policy

signing_key_id.description: Must match the key in the signers map

authorized_models.description: model_id values this key is permitted to sign for. A key may not sign for a model not in this list.

key_status.description: Operational status. suspended = temporarily inactive. revoked = permanently invalid; reject all signatures.

rotation_state.description: active: normal use. rotating: new key is primary, this key still accepted during overlap window. verification_only: no new signatures accepted, existing in-flight intents may still be verified. retired: no verification accepted.

rotation_overlap_window_seconds.description: How long after rotation begins this key remains valid for verification. Required when rotation_state is rotating or verification_only.

successor_key_id.description: The key_id that replaces this key during rotation. Required when rotation_state is rotating.

signature_algorithm.description: Algorithm Nano must use to verify signatures from this key

public_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key. Used to detect key substitution attacks.
